# The visual reference — do not edit

`index.html` + `styles.css` are the approved static prototype for the public
Race Pace Durability plan, made outside this repo on 5 September 2026 and
approved as-is. `reference.png` is the image it was built from.

**This is a specification, not a starting point.** It is kept here permanently as
a visual regression fixture: when a surface is rebuilt in this language, its
screenshot goes beside this file and the difference is a defect, not a variation.

Approved deviations from `reference.png`, and the only ones:

- the photographic tile in the upper-left hero is removed; the title starts further left.

The matrix uses **Variation 1 — refined borders**: the full grid stays, border
contrast drops substantially. Structurally obvious without looking boxed in.

Standing instruction from Brice, recorded verbatim because it keeps being lost:

> I hate that every time we do a mock up I like it and then we design the HTML
> and the idea gets changed. I'd rather remove things when we get close to the
> mock up, not after.

So: reproduce first, subtract later. A difference from this reference is reported,
never resolved creatively.
